errors.text: The hypothesis makes Ostwald ripening and transfer of material into larger particles a central mechanism, whereas the target attributes the dominant size loss to Au/Cu surface segregation followed by melting and evaporation.
It predicts a shift toward larger average particle size, conflicting with the reported reduction in average particle size and approximately 22% size reduction.
The proposed atom-probe measurements on quenched samples would provide concentration profiles but would not directly measure element-specific self-diffusion coefficients during heating.
